sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getInitParameter_1
sql-service.description: 평가표 화면 로드에 필요한 기본 파라미터 조회
sql-service.query: SELECT TM_NO, -- TM설계번호 CON_ENT_DGN_NO, -- 가입설계번호 CON_APP_DATE, -- 청약일자 CON_I_KIND_CD -- 상품코드 FROM TSOWN.TB_INSU_PLAN_MAST WHERE CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?ENT_DGN_NO

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getInitParameter_2
sql-service.description: 평가표 화면 로드에 필요한 기본 파라미터 조회
sql-service.query: SELECT USERID, -- 사용자ID USERNAME, -- 사용자명 CALLAUTH, -- 제휴사구분 TREATYCD, -- 취급자코드 TREATYBRHCD AS ORG2_CD, -- 센터 TREATYDEPTCD AS ORG3_CD -- 팀 FROM TSOWN.TB_USER WHERE USERID = ?USER_ID

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getTMCodes.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT CODETYPE, CODE, CODENAME, ETCCODE1, ETCCODE2 FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODETYPE = ?CODETYPE AND CODE <> '000000'

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getWorkDate.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') > MIN(BASE_DATE) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CLSE_YN --마감일자 체크 ,CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') = SUBSTR(?APP_DATE,0,6) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MOD_YN --당월이면 Y, 아니면 N FROM TSOWN.TB_WORKDATE WHERE DOW_TC NOT IN ('6','0') -- DOW_TC : 요일코드 AND BNK_HDAY_YN != 'Y' -- BNK_HDAY_YN : 휴일 여부 AND BASE_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(?APP_DATE,0,6) || ?CLSE_DAY,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMMDD')

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getDmboStatus.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT DMBO_CD FROM TSOWN.TBIC063 WHERE TM_NO = ?TM_NO

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getQAEvaluateStatus.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT TIPM.TM_PROCESSING_GB AS PRE_TM_PROCESSING_GB /** 현심사상태 */ , ( SELECT DECODE(COUNT(CON_ENT_DGN_NO), 0, 'N', 'Y') FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY WHERE CON_ENT_DGN_NO = TIPM.CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND QACD = ?QACD ) AS RESULT_YN /** 결과여부 */ , (SELECT MAX(ESTRESULTCD) KEEP(DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY HTID DESC) FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY TEH WHERE TEH.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = TIPM.CON_ENT_DGN_NO) AS RESULT_CD /** 심사결과 */ , (SELECT MAX(QACD) KEEP(DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY HTID DESC) FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY TEH WHERE TEH.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = TIPM.CON_ENT_DGN_NO) AS CUR_QACD /** 최종심사단계 */ , NVL((SELECT MAX(HTID) KEEP(DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY HTID DESC) FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY TEH WHERE TEH.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = TIPM.CON_ENT_DGN_NO),0) AS CUR_HTID /** 최종HTID값 */ , NVL((SELECT MAX(HTDGREE) KEEP(DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY HTID DESC) FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY TEH WHERE TEH.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = TIPM.CON_ENT_DGN_NO),0) AS CUR_HTDGREE /** 최종HTDGREE값 */ , CASE WHEN PLS_DECRYPT_B64(TIPM.CON_P_PSN_NO) = PLS_DECRYPT_B64(TIPD.CON_IP_ISD_CD) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PSN_YN , TIPM.CON_POL_NO AS CON_POL_NO /** 증권번호 */ , TIPM.CON_ENT_DGN_NO AS CON_ENT_DGN_NO /** 설계번호 */ , TIPM.CON_I_KIND_CD AS CON_I_KIND_CD /** 상품코드 **/ , TIPM.CON_P_CUST_NO AS CUSTNO , TIPM.CON_P_CONT_NAME AS CON_P_NAME , TIPD.CON_IP_INS_CUST_NO AS CON_IP_CUST_NO , PLS_DECRYPT_B64(TIPM.CON_P_PSN_NO) AS CON_P_PSN_NO , TIPM.CON_APP_DATE AS CON_APP_DATE , NVL(TIPM.DSGN_DEL_YN,'N') AS DEL_YN , NVL(CON_ETC_FIELD_1,'N') AS AUTO_YN , TIPM.CON_CON_EXP_Y_CNT AS CON_CON_EXP_Y_CNT , TIPD.CON_IP_CONT_AGE AS CON_IP_CONT_AGE , PLS_DECRYPT_B64(TIPD.CON_IP_ISD_CD) AS CON_IP_ISD_CD , CASE WHEN TIPM.CON_POL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'N' WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') <> SUBSTR(TIPM.CON_CON_OLT_PROP_YMD, 1 ,6) THEN 'Y' WHEN TIPM.POA_WAIT_YN = 'Y' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') = SUBSTR(TIPM.CON_CON_OLT_PROP_YMD, 1 ,6) THEN 'N' WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN SUBSTR(TIPM.CON_CON_OLT_PROP_YMD, 1, 8) AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TIPM.CON_CON_OLT_PROP_YMD, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') + 9,'YYYYMMDD') THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS EXPIRED_YN FROM TSOWN.TB_INSU_PLAN_MAST TIPM ,TSOWN.TB_INSU_PLAN_DETAIL TIPD WHERE TIPM.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND TIPM.TM_NO = TIPD.TM_NO

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getViewStatus.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT CASE WHEN CON_ETC_FIELD_4 IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(CON_ETC_FIELD_4,1,8) ELSE '' END AS USERID ,CASE WHEN CON_ETC_FIELD_4 IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT USERNAME FROM TSOWN.TB_USER WHERE USERID = SUBSTR(CON_ETC_FIELD_4,0,8)) ELSE '' END AS USERNM ,CASE WHEN CON_ETC_FIELD_4 IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT TREATYBRHNM FROM TSOWN.TB_USER WHERE USERID = SUBSTR(CON_ETC_FIELD_4,0,8)) ELSE '' END AS USER_TEAM , CASE WHEN CON_ETC_FIELD_4 IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT CODENAME FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODETYPE = 'SYS999' AND CODE = (SELECT USERLEVEL FROM TSOWN.TB_USER WHERE USERID = SUBSTR(CON_ETC_FIELD_4,1,8)) ) ELSE '' END AS USER_LEVEL ,CASE WHEN CON_ETC_FIELD_4 IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(CON_ETC_FIELD_4,9),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE '' END AS OPEN_DATE ,CASE WHEN CON_ETC_FIELD_4 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS OPEN_YN , CON_ETC_FIELD_4 FROM TSOWN.TB_INSU_PLAN_MAST WHERE CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.setViewStatus.upd
sql-service.query: UPDATE TSOWN.TB_INSU_PLAN_MAST SET CON_ETC_FIELD_4 = ?type WHERE CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getOpinionDetailQc.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT ROWNUM AS NO /** 순번 */ , DTL.ESTRESULTCD AS ESTRESULTCDGD /** 심사결과코드_Grid */ , DTL.ESTRESULTCD AS ESTRESULTCD /** 심사결과코드 */ , DTL.ESTREGISTDT AS ESTREGISTDT /** 심사일자 */ , DTL.PROCESS_DATE AS PROCESS_DATE /** 수정일자 */ , DTL.RT_PROCESS_DATE AS RT_PROCESS_DATE /** 재심일자 */ , DTL.CON_ENT_DGN_NO AS CON_ENT_DGN_NO /** 설계번호 */ , DTL.QACD AS QACD /** 심사항목QACD */ , DTL.HTDGREE AS HTDGREE /** 보완차수 */ , DTL.HTID AS HTID /** 이력ID */ , DTL.ESTOPINION AS ESTOPINION /** 심사자의견 */ , DTL.QAOPINION AS QAOPINION /** QA심사의뢰 의견*/ , DTL.RTOPINION AS RTOPINION /** 상담원의견 */ , (SELECT USERNAME FROM TSOWN.TB_USER WHERE USERID = DTL.ESTREGISTID) AS ESTREGISTID /** 심사자 */ , DTL.EST_ITEM_VER AS EST_ITEM_VER /** 평가표VER */ , (SELECT A.RTOPINION FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY A WHERE A.QACD = '' AND A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = DTL.CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND A.HTID = DTL.HTID) AS RTOPINION1 /** 상담원재심의견 */ , DTL.MOD_YN AS MODYN FROM ( SELECT ESTRESULTCD AS ESTRESULTCD , ESTREGISTDT AS ESTREGISTDT /** 심사일자 */ , PROCESS_DATE AS PROCESS_DATE /** 수정일자 */ , RT_PROCESS_DATE AS RT_PROCESS_DATE /** 재심일자 */ , CON_ENT_DGN_NO AS CON_ENT_DGN_NO , QACD AS QACD , HTDGREE AS HTDGREE , HTID AS HTID , ESTOPINION AS ESTOPINION , QAOPINION AS QAOPINION , RTOPINION AS RTOPINION , ESTREGISTID AS ESTREGISTID , EST_ITEM_VER AS EST_ITEM_VER , (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(HTID) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HIST_DT WHERE HTID = A.HTID AND HTDGREE = A.HTDGREE) AS MOD_YN FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY A WHERE 1=1 AND CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO AND QACD = ?QACD ORDER BY HTDGREE DESC ) DTL

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getEvaluateCodes.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT CODETYPE ,CODE ,CODENAME ,CODEGROUP ,SORTKEY ,ISCHANGABLE ,CODEDEPTH ,(SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(CODE)) FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODEGROUP = 'RST' AND NVL(CODEDEPTH,'NULL') != '1') AS MAXCODE FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODEGROUP = 'RST' ?code_type ?code_depth ORDER BY SORTKEY ASC ,CODENAME ASC

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getEvalListNew.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT A.EST_ITEM_VER ,A.EST_CD_ID ,A.ESTFCATCD ,A.ESTSCATCD ,A.ESTSCATNM ,A.ESTTCATCD ,A.ESTTCATNM ,A.MAIN_NO ,A.SMALL_NO ,CASE WHEN A.SMALL_NO = 0 THEN TO_CHAR(A.MAIN_NO) ELSE TO_CHAR(A.MAIN_NO) || '-' || TO_CHAR(A.SMALL_NO) END AS TOT_NO ,A.QST_CONT ,A.ORD_NO ,A.ESTUSEYN ,A.QACD ,A.ESTETC ,B.ESTRESULTCD ,B.ESTRESULTCD AS ETCCD ,CASE WHEN A.ESTETC = 'RST999' THEN 'checkbox' WHEN A.ESTETC = 'RST888' THEN 'normal' ELSE 'combo' END AS ETCGB ,B.QUEST_MEMO AS QUEST_MEMO ,B.RCV_MEMO AS RCV_MEMO ,A.ESTREGISTDT ,A.ESTREGISTID ,CASE WHEN B.CNT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CNTYN FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_ITEM A ,( SELECT A.HTID ,A.ESTTCATCD ,A.ESTRESULTCD ,A.QUEST_MEMO ,A.RCV_MEMO ,B.EST_ITEM_VER ,B.SC_CD_ID ,ROWNUM AS CNT FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_RESULT_HIST A ,TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY B WHERE A.HTID = B.HTID AND B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO ?qacd ?htid ) B WHERE A.ESTTCATCD = B.ESTTCATCD(+) AND A.EST_ITEM_VER = DECODE(B.EST_ITEM_VER,'',(SELECT MAX(EST_ITEM_VER) FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_ITEM WHERE ESTUSEYN='Y'),B.EST_ITEM_VER) ORDER BY ORD_NO ASC ,MAIN_NO ASC ,SMALL_NO ASC

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getEvalList.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT A.EST_ITEM_VER ,A.EST_CD_ID ,A.ESTFCATCD ,A.ESTSCATCD ,A.ESTSCATNM ,A.ESTTCATCD ,A.ESTTCATNM ,A.MAIN_NO ,A.SMALL_NO ,CASE WHEN A.SMALL_NO = 0 THEN TO_CHAR(A.MAIN_NO) ELSE TO_CHAR(A.MAIN_NO) || '-' || TO_CHAR(A.SMALL_NO) END AS TOT_NO ,A.QST_CONT ,A.ORD_NO ,A.ESTUSEYN ,A.QACD ,A.ESTETC ,B.ESTRESULTCD ,B.ESTRESULTCD AS ETCCD ,CASE WHEN A.ESTETC = '99' THEN 'checkbox' WHEN NVL(A.ESTETC,'NULL') = 'NULL' THEN 'normal' ELSE 'combo' END AS ETCGB ,B.QUEST_MEMO AS QUEST_MEMO ,B.RCV_MEMO AS RCV_MEMO ,A.ESTREGISTDT ,A.ESTREGISTID ,CASE WHEN B.CNT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CNTYN FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_ITEM A ,( SELECT A.HTID ,A.ESTTCATCD ,A.ESTRESULTCD ,A.QUEST_MEMO ,A.RCV_MEMO ,B.EST_ITEM_VER ,B.SC_CD_ID ,ROWNUM AS CNT FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_RESULT_HIST A ,TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY B WHERE A.HTID = B.HTID AND B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO ?QACD ?HTID ) B WHERE A.ESTTCATCD = B.ESTTCATCD(+) AND A.EST_ITEM_VER = '1' -- 평가표 VERSION 1만 형태가 달라서 이렇게 쿼리를 따로 둠 ORDER BY ORD_NO ASC ,MAIN_NO ASC ,SMALL_NO ASC

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getTmProcessingGB.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT TM_PROCESSING_GB , CON_CAMP_CD , CON_TREATY_CD , CASE WHEN CON_CAMP_CD IS NOT NULL THEN CON_CAMP_CD ELSE CON_TREATY_CD END AS DGN_USER_ID FROM TSOWN.TB_INSU_PLAN_MAST WHERE CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.savetbPreEstHistory.ins

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.savetbPreEstHistoryLog.ins
sql-service.query: INSERT INTO TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY_LOG ( LOGSEQID , CON_ENT_DGN_NO , QACD , HTDGREE , HTID , ESTRESULTCD , ESTOPINION , RTOPINION , ESTREGISTDT , ESTREGISTID , QAOPINION , EST_ITEM_VER , SC_CD_ID ) VALUES ( TSOWN.SEQ_HOLI_SEQ.NEXTVAL , ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO , ?QACD , ?HTDGREE , ?HTID , ?ESTRESULTCD , ?ESTOPINION , ?RTOPINION , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') , ?ESTREGISTID , ?QAOPINION , ?EST_ITEM_VER , ?SC_CD_ID )

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.savetbPreEstHistoryLog2.ins
sql-service.query: INSERT INTO TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY_LOG ( LOGSEQID , CON_ENT_DGN_NO , QACD , HTDGREE , HTID , ESTRESULTCD , ESTOPINION , RTOPINION , ESTREGISTDT , ESTREGISTID , RT_PROCESS_DATE , QAOPINION , EST_ITEM_VER , SC_CD_ID ) VALUES ( TSOWN.SEQ_HOLI_SEQ.NEXTVAL , ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO , ?QACD , (SELECT NVL(MAX(HTDGREE), 0) FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY WHERE CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO) , ?HTID , ?ESTRESULTCD , ?ESTOPINION , ?RTOPINION , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') , ?ESTREGISTID , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') , ?QAOPINION , ?EST_ITEM_VER , ?SC_CD_ID )

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.savetbPreEstHistoryLog3.ins
sql-service.query: INSERT INTO TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY_LOG ( LOGSEQID , CON_ENT_DGN_NO , QACD , HTDGREE , HTID , ESTRESULTCD , ESTOPINION , RTOPINION , RTREGISTDT , ESTREGISTID , PROCESS_DATE , QAOPINION , EST_ITEM_VER , SC_CD_ID ) VALUES ( TSOWN.SEQ_HOLI_SEQ.NEXTVAL , ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO , ?QACD , (SELECT NVL(MAX(HTDGREE), 0) FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY WHERE CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO) , ?HTID , ?ESTRESULTCD , ?ESTOPINION , ?RTOPINION , ?RTREGISTDT , ?ESTREGISTID , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') , ?QAOPINION , ?EST_ITEM_VER , ?SC_CD_ID )

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.savetbPreEstHistDT.ins
sql-service.query: INSERT INTO TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HIST_DT ( HTID ,REG_DT ,REG_TM ,HTDGREE ,PRE_RST_CD ,MOD_RST_CD ,EST_CD_ID ,EST_ITEM_VER ,ESTTCATCD ,ORD_NO ) VALUES ( ?HTID ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') ,?HTDGREE ,?PRE_RST_CD ,?MOD_RST_CD ,?EST_CD_ID ,?EST_ITEM_VER ,?ESTTCATCD ,(SELECT NVL(MAX(ORD_NO),0)+1 FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HIST_DT) )

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.updatetbInsuPlanMast.upd

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getPreEstItemModListNew.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT HTID AS HTID ,HTDGREE AS HTDGREE ,CASE WHEN B.ESTETC = 'RST999' THEN CASE WHEN PRE_RST_CD = '1' THEN '선택' ELSE '미선택' END ELSE CASE WHEN B.ESTETC != 'RST999' AND B.ESTETC != 'RST888' THEN (SELECT CODENAME FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODETYPE = B.ESTETC AND CODE = PRE_RST_CD) ELSE PRE_RST_CD END END AS PRE_RST_CD ,CASE WHEN B.ESTETC = 'RST999' THEN CASE WHEN MOD_RST_CD = '1' THEN '선택' ELSE '미선택' END ELSE CASE WHEN B.ESTETC != 'RST999' AND B.ESTETC != 'RST888' THEN (SELECT CODENAME FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODETYPE = B.ESTETC AND CODE = MOD_RST_CD) ELSE MOD_RST_CD END END AS MOD_RST_CD ,B.ESTSCATNM AS ESTSCATNM ,B.ESTTCATNM ESTTCATNM ,B.MAIN_NO AS MAIN_NO ,B.SMALL_NO AS SMALL_NO ,CASE WHEN B.SMALL_NO = 0 THEN TO_CHAR(B.MAIN_NO) ELSE TO_CHAR(B.MAIN_NO) || '-' || TO_CHAR(B.SMALL_NO) END AS TOT_NO ,REG_DT || REG_TM AS REG_DT FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HIST_DT A ,TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_ITEM B WHERE HTID = ?HTID AND HTDGREE = ?HTDGREE AND A.EST_ITEM_VER = B.EST_ITEM_VER AND A.EST_CD_ID = B.EST_CD_ID AND A.ESTTCATCD = B.ESTTCATCD ORDER BY A.ESTTCATCD ASC ,MAIN_NO ASC ,SMALL_NO ASC

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getPreEstItemModList.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT A.HTID, A.HTDGREE, A.PRE_RST_CD, A.MOD_RST_CD, A.REG_DT, A.ESTSCATNM, A.ESTTCATNM, A.MAIN_NO, A.SMALL_NO, CASE WHEN A.SMALL_NO = 0 THEN TO_CHAR(A.MAIN_NO) ELSE TO_CHAR(A.MAIN_NO) || '-' || TO_CHAR(A.SMALL_NO) END AS TOT_NO FROM (SELECT HTID AS HTID ,HTDGREE AS HTDGREE ,CASE WHEN PRE_RST_CD = '0' OR PRE_RST_CD = '1' THEN CASE WHEN PRE_RST_CD = '1' THEN '선택' ELSE '미선택' END ELSE CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRE_RST_CD) = 2 THEN (SELECT CODENAME FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODETYPE = 'EST201' AND CODE = PRE_RST_CD) ELSE PRE_RST_CD END END AS PRE_RST_CD ,CASE WHEN MOD_RST_CD = '0' OR MOD_RST_CD = '1' THEN CASE WHEN MOD_RST_CD = '1' THEN '선택' ELSE '미선택' END ELSE CASE WHEN LENGTH(MOD_RST_CD) = 2 THEN (SELECT CODENAME FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODETYPE = 'EST201' AND CODE = MOD_RST_CD) ELSE MOD_RST_CD END END AS MOD_RST_CD ,REG_DT || REG_TM AS REG_DT ,(SELECT ESTSCATNM FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_ITEM WHERE ESTTCATCD = A.ESTTCATCD AND EST_ITEM_VER = ?EST_ITEM_VER) AS ESTSCATNM ,(SELECT ESTTCATNM FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_ITEM WHERE ESTTCATCD = A.ESTTCATCD AND EST_ITEM_VER = ?EST_ITEM_VER) AS ESTTCATNM ,(SELECT MAIN_NO FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_ITEM WHERE ESTTCATCD = A.ESTTCATCD AND EST_ITEM_VER = ?EST_ITEM_VER) AS MAIN_NO ,(SELECT SMALL_NO FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_ITEM WHERE ESTTCATCD = A.ESTTCATCD AND EST_ITEM_VER = ?EST_ITEM_VER) AS SMALL_NO ,A.ESTTCATCD FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HIST_DT A WHERE HTID = ?HTID AND HTDGREE = ?HTDGREE ) A ORDER BY ESTTCATCD ASC, MAIN_NO ASC, SMALL_NO ASC

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.saveTbAppActHist.ins
sql-service.query: INSERT INTO TSOWN.TB_APP_ACT_HIST ( HIST_SEQ , APP_ACT , CON_ENT_DGN_NO , PRT_CD , REG_DT , REG_TM , CUST_NO , CON_IP_PSN_NAME , REL_CD , ACT_HIST , CENTER_CD , TEAM_CD , AGENT_ID , AGENT_NM , CALL_ID , REC_ID ) VALUES ( SEQ_USERLOG.NEXTVAL , ?APP_ACT , NVL(TRIM(?CON_ENT_DGN_NO), ' ') , ?PRT_CD , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') , ?CUST_NO , ?CON_IP_PSN_NAME , ?REL_CD , ?ACT_HIST , ?CENTER_CD , ?TEAM_CD , ?AGENT_ID , ?AGENT_NM , ?CALL_ID , ?UCID )

sql-service.name: msens.est.hansol.getEstListExcel.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT ESTSCATNM, ESTTCATNM, TOT_NO, QST_CONT, CASE WHEN A.ETCGB = 'combo' THEN (SELECT CODENAME FROM TSOWN.TB_CODEBOOK WHERE CODEGROUP = 'RST' AND NVL(CODEDEPTH,'NULL') != '1' AND CODE = ETCCD) WHEN A.ETCGB = 'checkbox' THEN DECODE(NVL(ETCCD,0), 0, '미선택', '선택') ELSE NVL(ETCCD,'') END AS ETCGB_NM, CASE WHEN ESTETC = 'RST999' THEN 'checkbox' WHEN ESTETC = 'RST888' THEN 'normal' ELSE 'combo' END AS ETCGB, ESTRESULTCD AS ETCCD, QUEST_MEMO, RCV_MEMO FROM (SELECT A.EST_ITEM_VER ,A.EST_CD_ID ,A.ESTFCATCD ,A.ESTSCATCD ,A.ESTSCATNM ,A.ESTTCATCD ,A.ESTTCATNM ,A.MAIN_NO ,A.SMALL_NO ,CASE WHEN A.SMALL_NO = 0 THEN TO_CHAR(A.MAIN_NO) ELSE TO_CHAR(A.MAIN_NO) || '-' || TO_CHAR(A.SMALL_NO) END AS TOT_NO ,A.QST_CONT ,A.ORD_NO ,A.ESTUSEYN ,A.QACD ,A.ESTETC ,B.ESTRESULTCD ,B.ESTRESULTCD AS ETCCD ,CASE WHEN A.ESTETC = 'RST999' THEN 'checkbox' WHEN A.ESTETC = 'RST888' THEN 'normal' ELSE 'combo' END AS ETCGB ,B.QUEST_MEMO AS QUEST_MEMO ,B.RCV_MEMO AS RCV_MEMO ,A.ESTREGISTDT ,A.ESTREGISTID ,CASE WHEN B.CNT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CNTYN FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_ITEM A ,( SELECT A.HTID ,A.ESTTCATCD ,A.ESTRESULTCD ,A.QUEST_MEMO ,A.RCV_MEMO ,B.EST_ITEM_VER ,B.SC_CD_ID ,ROWNUM AS CNT FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_RESULT_HIST A ,TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_HISTORY B WHERE A.HTID = B.HTID AND B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = ?CON_ENT_DGN_NO ?qacd ?htid ) B WHERE A.ESTTCATCD = B.ESTTCATCD(+) AND A.EST_ITEM_VER = DECODE(B.EST_ITEM_VER,'',(SELECT MAX(EST_ITEM_VER) FROM TSOWN.TB_PRE_EST_ITEM WHERE ESTUSEYN='Y'),B.EST_ITEM_VER) ORDER BY ORD_NO ASC ,MAIN_NO ASC ,SMALL_NO ASC ) A
